name: agent-role-hub-monorepo
description: Universal, verifiable AI roles with independently versioned harness compatibility layers.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ishuowang/rolehub-core && npm run build -w @ishuowang/rolehub-compat-sdk && npm run build -w @ishuowang/rolehub-compat-claude-code && npm run build -w @ishuowang/rolehub-compat-codex && npm run build -w @ishuowang/rolehub-compat-opencode && npm run build -w @ishuowang/rolehub-compat-pi && npm run build -w @ishuowang/rolehub-compat-dsharness && npm run build -w @ishuowang/rolehub
scripts.catalog: node packages/cli/dist/cli.js catalog build --roles roles --out catalog/index.json --site site/catalog.json
scripts.compatibility:catalog: node packages/cli/dist/cli.js compat catalog --out compatibility/index.json --site site/compatibility.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm test && npm run validate:roles && npm run catalog && npm run compatibility:catalog && git diff --exit-code -- catalog/index.json compatibility/index.json site/catalog.json site/compatibility.json
